2609.08832.title: Closing the Consistency Gap: Self-Evolving Agents That Learn to Stay on Course
2609.08832.paper_summary: Large language model (LLM)-powered agents can be accurate on average yet unreliable in production, a discrepancy that has been observed but remains largely unaddressed. When given the same task five times, a ReAct agent on the AppWorld benchmark using GPT-4.1 succeeds in all five runs only 53% of the time, even though its per-run pass rate averages 77%. We call this 24-point shortfall the consistency gap, and we argue that addressing it is a precondition for trustworthy AI agent deployment. We present a self-evolving agent framework that reduces this gap by identifying unstable, low-consistency steps in agent trajectories and converting them into episodic memory the agent can draw on in future runs. At its core is a Consistency Analyzer that pinpoints where and why a trajectory is likely to flip across executions, and a Guideline Generator that converts the diagnosis into targeted guidelines, committed to memory and injected into future agent executions on similar tasks. On AppWorld with ReAct/GPT-4.1, our framework raises the fraction of tasks that succeed in all five runs by +16 points on same-task evaluation and +13 points on similar-task generalization.
2609.08832.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLM）驅動的代理在平均上可能是準確的，但在生產環境中卻不可靠，這一差異已被觀察到但仍然在很大程度上未得到解決。當同一任務被執行五次時，使用 GPT-4.1 的 ReAct 代理在 AppWorld 基準測試中僅有 53% 的時間在所有五次運行中都成功，儘管其每次運行的通過率平均為 77%。我們將這 24 點的差距稱為一致性差距，並主張解決這一問題是可信賴的 AI 代理部署的前提條件。我們提出了一個自我演變的代理框架，通過識別代理軌跡中不穩定、低一致性的步驟來縮小這一差距，並將其轉換為代理在未來運行中可以利用的情節記憶。其核心是一個一致性分析器，能夠確定軌跡在哪裡以及為什麼可能在執行過程中翻轉，還有一個指導生成器，將診斷轉化為針對性的指導，這些指導被記憶並注入到未來類似任務的代理執行中。在 AppWorld 上使用 ReAct/GPT-4.1，我們的框架將在所有五次運行中成功的任務比例提高了 +16 點（在同任務評估中）和 +13 點（在類似任務泛化中）。
